summary.zh: 生成可直接投产的 FastAPI 后端骨架

description.zh: 生成结构完整的 FastAPI 后端骨架，包含异步路由、依赖注入和统一的错误处理。适合从零搭建 API 服务，或为团队统一新项目的起始结构。需要本地已装好 Python 和依赖管理工具。
description.en: Generates a production-ready FastAPI backend skeleton with async routes, dependency injection, and consistent error handling. Fits new API services or a shared starting point for a team. Requires Python and a package manager locally.
